headings: A luminous, sophisticated floral amber fragrance with notes of tuberose, jasmine, amber, and cashmere woods.

jsonld_raw.name: AMBER IN BLOOM EDP 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
AMBER IN BLOOM EDP 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.). A fragrance that captures the beauty of a garden bathed in golden light. The exuberance of tuberose and the delicacy of jasmine reveal a luminous and sophisticated floral bouquet. Amber and cashmere woods envelop the composition with a soft, velvety warmth that lingers on the skin with natural elegance.

Amber floral | Luminous, enveloping, and sophisticated
